test_title: PYST 35: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

He has recovered now and is feeling __too strong to walk__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"too"** means to a higher degree than is desirable, permissible, or possible; excessively. (बहुत)

 
 
• **Example:** He was** too** tired to continue the journey.
 
 
 
• **"Strong enough"** means having sufficient strength to perform an action. (पर्याप्त मजबूत)
 
 
• **Example:** She is **strong enough** to lift the heavy box.
 
 

Hence, the phrase should be **"strong enough to walk"** instead of **"too strong to walk"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: too weak to walk** (चलने के लिए बहुत कमजोर): This means not having enough strength to walk.

 
 
• **Example:** After the illness, he was too weak to walk.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: weak enough to walk** (चलने के लिए पर्याप्त कमजोर): This phrase is incorrect as it contradicts itself.
 
 
• **Example:** This option does not make logical sense.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: strong to walk** (चलने के लिए मजबूत): This phrase is grammatically incorrect.
 
 
• **Example:** He is strong enough to walk.
 
 

40:Tc93,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
